rca_of_the_issue.original_issue: Income History showing future dates (e.g., Feb 14 when today is Jan 29)
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The /api/income/daily-roi endpoint was generating ROI entries based on days_completed without checking if the calculated date was in the future
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added check at line 1483 in server.py: 'if roi_date > now: continue' to skip any ROI entries where the calculated date would be in the future
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Backend test confirms 0 future dates in API response. Frontend UI shows only dates from Jan 27-29, 2026
